verdict.rationale: Chargebee's MCP evidence is entirely server-side: it exposes its own tools to external AI clients such as Cursor and Claude, and lets users build custom MCP servers from its catalog. There is no evidence that Chargebee's in-product AI can connect to external MCP servers and use their tools. The axis still applies because Chargebee ships in-product AI that could plausibly act as an MCP client, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
